newsitem.title: USA: American Brands sees EPS up 10 pct in '97.
newsitem.headline: American Brands sees EPS up 10 pct in '97.

text.p: American Brands Inc said Friday it expects earnings per share to grow by 10 percent in 1997.
The company said that when it sold American Tobacco Co at the end of 1994, it established a long-term goal of earnings per share growth in the range of 10 percent annually.
It said it exceeded this goal in 1995 and 1996, and if there were no spin-off of its UK-based Gallaher tobacco business, it would likely achieve the goal in 1997, excluding restructuring charges.
The company announced in October plans to spin off Gallaher to its shareholders. Steps to implement the spin-off are progressing, it said.
When the transaction is consummated, the company said it plans to change the name American Brands to Fortune Brands.
Completion of the transaction, expected around mid-year, is pending receipt of favorable tax rulings and relevant stockholder approvals, it said.
